item.title: No plan to boycott election: Nasiruddin Patwary
item.description: Jatiya Nagorik Party (NCP) chief coordinator and the candidate of the 11-party alliance in Dhaka-8, Nasiruddin Patwary said that his alliance has no plans to boycott the ongoing election.He said, “We are closely monitoring the situation as part of the 11-party alliance. So far, we have no such plan. People are coming out to vote and the atmosphere is festive. item.title: Messi suffers hamstring strain, doubtful for Inter Miami’s MLS opener

item.title: Deaths in Iran's crackdown on protests reach at least 7,000, activists say
item.description: The death toll from a crackdown over Iran's nationwide protests last month has reached at least 7,002 people killed with many more still feared dead, activists said Thursday.The slow rise in the number of dead from the demonstrations adds to the overall tensions facing Iran both inside the country and abroad as it tries to negotiate with the United States over its nuclear program.
